title: GitHub Actions Runners (ARC)
description: Self-hosted GitHub Actions runners: Actions Runner Controller (flux/helm/arc-controller) and its runner scale sets (flux/helm/arc-runners).

panels.description: Whether Prometheus can scrape the Actions Runner Controller (arc-system).
panels.title: Controller

panels.description: Listeners Prometheus can scrape, out of the scale sets the controller runs. Each scale set has one listener pod in arc-system holding a long poll to GitHub; without it no runner starts.
panels.title: Listeners

panels.description: Registered runners running a job, as GitHub reports them to the listener.
panels.title: Busy runners

panels.description: Registered runners waiting for a job. Scale sets run with minRunners 0, so this is normally 0 between jobs.
panels.title: Idle runners

panels.description: Jobs GitHub has assigned to the scale set that are not running yet (assigned minus running): queued behind maxRunners, or waiting for a runner VM to boot.
panels.title: Waiting for a runner

panels.description: Jobs that finished in the selected time range, from the runner logs in Loki (every job, including those before the listener exported metrics).

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({namespace="arc-runners", container="runner", pod=~"(${scale_set:regex})-runner-.+"} |~ "^[0-9-]+ [0-9:]+Z: Job .+ completed with result: " | regexp "Job (?P<job_name>.+) completed with result: (?P<result>\\w+)" [$__range]))

panels.title: Jobs finished

panels.description: Share of the jobs finished in the selected time range that succeeded, from the runner logs.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({namespace="arc-runners", container="runner", pod=~"(${scale_set:regex})-runner-.+"} |~ "^[0-9-]+ [0-9:]+Z: Job .+ completed with result: " | regexp "Job (?P<job_name>.+) completed with result: (?P<result>\\w+)" | result="Succeeded" [$__range])) / sum(count_over_time({namespace="arc-runners", container="runner", pod=~"(${scale_set:regex})-runner-.+"} |~ "^[0-9-]+ [0-9:]+Z: Job .+ completed with result: " | regexp "Job (?P<job_name>.+) completed with result: (?P<result>\\w+)" [$__range]))

panels.title: Succeeded

panels.description: Median time from a job being assigned until it started on a runner, over the selected time range: the runner pod scheduling, booting its Kata VM and registering with GitHub.
panels.title: Median wait

panels.description: The listener's view of each scale set: how many runners it wants, how many are registered with GitHub, busy and idle, and the scale set's maxRunners cap.
panels.title: Runners

panels.description: Jobs assigned to the scale set and jobs running. The gap between them is jobs waiting for a runner.
panels.title: Jobs

panels.description: What the controller has created: runners pending (pod starting, not yet given a job), running a job, and failed. Failed runners are retried by the controller; a count that stays up means pods cannot start.
panels.title: Ephemeral runners

panels.description: Runner pods that exist, by node. Each is a Kata VM; scale sets keep them off t8o (8GiB).
panels.title: Runner pods by node

panels.description: Jobs finished each hour by result, from the runner logs.

targets.expr: sum by (result) (count_over_time({namespace="arc-runners", container="runner", pod=~"(${scale_set:regex})-runner-.+"} |~ "^[0-9-]+ [0-9:]+Z: Job .+ completed with result: " | regexp "Job (?P<job_name>.+) completed with result: (?P<result>\\w+)" [1h]))

panels.title: Jobs finished per hour

panels.description: Jobs finished each hour by job name, from the runner logs.

targets.expr: sum by (job_name) (count_over_time({namespace="arc-runners", container="runner", pod=~"(${scale_set:regex})-runner-.+"} |~ "^[0-9-]+ [0-9:]+Z: Job .+ completed with result: " | regexp "Job (?P<job_name>.+) completed with result: (?P<result>\\w+)" [1h]))

panels.title: Jobs finished per hour by name

panels.description: p50 and p95 of the time from a job being assigned until it started, per hour.
panels.title: Wait for a runner

panels.description: p50 and p95 of how long jobs ran, per job name over each hour.
panels.title: Job duration

panels.description: Jobs finished in the selected time range, by job name and result, from the runner logs.

targets.expr: sum by (job_name, result) (count_over_time({namespace="arc-runners", container="runner", pod=~"(${scale_set:regex})-runner-.+"} |~ "^[0-9-]+ [0-9:]+Z: Job .+ completed with result: " | regexp "Job (?P<job_name>.+) completed with result: (?P<result>\\w+)" [$__range]))

panels.title: Jobs by name

panels.description: Each job's start and result, from the runner logs.

targets.expr: {namespace="arc-runners", container="runner", pod=~"(${scale_set:regex})-runner-.+"} |~ "^[0-9-]+ [0-9:]+Z: (Running job: |Job .+ completed with result: )"

panels.title: Jobs

panels.description: CPU used by each runner pod. Measured on the pod's cgroup on the node, so it includes the Kata VM (guest kernel, agent and both containers): Kata hides the containers from cAdvisor.
panels.title: CPU per runner

panels.description: Working set of each runner pod. Measured on the pod's cgroup on the node, so it includes the Kata VM (guest kernel, agent and both containers): Kata hides the containers from cAdvisor. The dind sidecar may use up to 8Gi (image builds land on a tmpfs inside the VM).
panels.title: Memory per runner

panels.description: Traffic on each runner pod's eth0: receive above zero, transmit below. Runners reach only the internet and cluster DNS.
panels.title: Network per runner

panels.description: Reconciles per second by controller, and errors.
panels.title: Reconciles

panels.description: RSS of the controller and each listener (arc-system).
panels.title: Memory

panels.description: arc-system, without the listener's per-poll lines.
panels.title: Controller and listener logs
